labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for a wider type on Table title, a new behaviour; features need Discussions approval first.

body:
This is a feature request, so it needs approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before it can be taken as an issue, as the [feature template](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md) explains. Please start a Discussion describing the use case there.

A similar request for the same field, #4171, was closed earlier, so please read that thread before opening the Discussion. The `title` parameter is typed in [rich/table.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/table.py).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
